text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen—a race where the
competitors
are decided on by the fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан's achievements in the
Classics have
been well received, and
she's earned her place
here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
McQueen! You'll be running in the Arima
Kinen
too, won't you?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I worked myself too hard leading up to
the
Kikuka Sho. Thus, I will be
dedicating myself to
preparing for next
year's important races.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Well then, good day. I hope you enjoy
this
gathering of monstrous racers.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Monstrous racers... Is she referring to the
seniors
running in the Arima Kinen?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Th-that's... Огури Кэп! The one everyone
says is in
the "Beast" class.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Everyone knows her. She's a super
famous
megastar...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Sh-she's so popular... And just look at
that aura
she puts out...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Uh, y-yeah... I just realized what a crazy
place I've
come to.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Until now, going to the Classics and
racing
McQueen was my everything. But
there's so much
more out there besides
that!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen... So this is the Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: Do you think you'll be okay?

text_block_list.text: Oh, o-of course! I'm not gonna lose!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But... I'm pretty scared. Oguri is—no, it's
not just
Oguri. The competition here is
endless...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
